sections.title: Employee Handbook
sections.heading: Time Off
sections.text: Submit time off requests in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead. Full-time employees earn 15 vacation days per year.

sections.title: Employee Handbook
sections.heading: Dress Code
sections.text: Business casual dress is expected Monday through Thursday. Casual dress is allowed on Fridays.

sections.title: Employee Handbook
sections.heading: Work Hours
sections.text: Core work hours are 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Outside those hours, schedules are flexible with your manager's approval.

sections.title: Employee Handbook
sections.heading: Remote Work
sections.text: Employees may work remotely (work from home) up to two days per week after completing their first 30 days.

sections.title: Benefits Guide
sections.heading: Health Insurance
sections.text: Enroll in health insurance within 30 days of your start date through the benefits portal. Coverage begins on the first day of the following month.

sections.title: Benefits Guide
sections.heading: Retirement Plan
sections.text: Brightpath will match your 401k retirement contributions up to 4 percent of your salary. You can enroll at any time.

sections.title: IT and Security Policy
sections.heading: Laptop Setup
sections.text: To set up your laptop, sign in with the temporary password from IT, then follow the setup checklist emailed on your first day.

sections.title: IT and Security Policy
sections.heading: Passwords
sections.text: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are changed every 90 days. Never share your password, including with IT staff.

sections.title: Payroll FAQ
sections.heading: Pay Schedule
sections.text: Employees are paid every other Friday. Your first paycheck arrives on the second payday after your start date.

sections.title: Payroll FAQ
sections.heading: Direct Deposit
sections.text: Set up direct deposit in the payroll portal under Profile, then Banking. Changes take one pay period to apply.
